leadText: Team Falinks (Japanese: タイレーツ団 Tairetsu-dan) is a team shown in Pokémon: Path to the Peak. It is made up of the best Pokémon TCG players in the world and is led by current World Champion Edgar Troy.
plainText:
Team Falinks (Japanese: タイレーツ団 Tairetsu-dan) is a team shown in Pokémon: Path to the Peak. It is made up of the best Pokémon TCG players in the world and is led by current World Champion Edgar Troy.
==History==
 
 

==Members==
 

==Decks==
All Team Falinks members use a -based deck.

According to Celestine, their deck borders on "perfection", being able to easily beat veteran players. As the team's name suggests, one of the mainstays of the members' deck is , the focus of at least three of the five team members' decks.
===Edgar Troy's deck===
 
Unlike the other members of his team, Edgar used a deck with a strategy of his own and focused on luring his opponents into a "trap".
